# ON Next Web (https://www.onnextweb.in)

> ON Next Web is a website development, custom software engineering, and digital services agency based in New Delhi, India. We design and build modern, high-performance web applications, enterprise software solutions, e-commerce storefronts, and digital search campaigns for businesses across Delhi NCR and globally.

## Core Capabilities & Services

- **Web Development**: Next.js, React, Node.js, TypeScript, Headless CMS integration, responsive UX, semantic HTML5, and Core Web Vitals optimization.
- **Custom Software Development**: Enterprise web portals, RESTful API architecture, database design (MongoDB, PostgreSQL), internal workflow automation, and SaaS platforms.
- **Digital Marketing & Technical SEO**: Technical website audits, semantic schema indexation, Google Search Console optimization, and local organic visibility strategies.
